about: Tex as it runs: every step, its model, effort, on or off, time limit, rounds and the context it reads in order, and every wire. The Tex Architecture Lab opens this as main and promotes a version by changing this file in a pull request; the gateway reads it. Nothing else holds these values (Dev2, 2026-11-13).

intake.label: Intake
intake.goal: A text arrives, is edited or unsent; Triage, Decide, Queue and React choose whether and when Tex answers, and the Door gathers what the turn needs or answers in code.

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.goal: Long work in the background: the job, its advisor and the hand-back judge.

tools-subagents.label: Tools & subagents
tools-subagents.goal: The tools Front door calls and the helpers they use: mail, card and egress checks, the picture maker and the advisor.

staff-messages.label: Staff messages
staff-messages.goal: Texts staff send through Tex from the console, such as a chat moving to the new number.

retired.label: Turned off (deleted after Promote)
retired.goal: Steps folded into the new ones above. Promote keeps main's steps turned off, never deleted; the cleanup after Promote deletes them and their code.

nodes.label: Check-in
nodes.goal: Three times a day, look at what changed in their workspace, mail and calendar, and text them only what can't wait; most looks stay quiet. Runs the front door with its own read-only tools and setup model.

nodes.label: Routine runs
nodes.goal: Start a routine (a note under tex/routines/) on its schedule as a routine, not as a text: gather the routine, its past runs and when the person last reacted to or answered one, so Front door knows it's a routine, judges whether it is still relevant or stale, and asks the person whether to keep it when nobody has engaged with it.

nodes.label: Send through Tex
nodes.goal: Another AI connected to Context asks Tex to text the person (send notify) because something needs them now; their settings decide whether it goes, and it is texted as written, with no model.

nodes.label: A text arrives
nodes.goal: Take every text, picture or tapback from iMessage or WhatsApp and get it into the chat's record before anything decides about it.

nodes.label: Old number intake
nodes.goal: When staff have switched Tex's old Sendblue line to redirect, a text that arrives on it takes no turn and gets one short reply naming the new number, at most once a day per chat (later texts that day are held); every other text goes on to Triage.

nodes.label: A text is edited or unsent
nodes.goal: When someone edits or unsends a text they sent (iMessage Edit and Undo Send, on the Photon line; Sendblue sends neither), keep it in the chat beside the text it changes. An edit that changes nothing does nothing; any other edit goes on to Triage as a text of its own, marked as the edit, and Decide judges it from its examples (a fixed typo can go quiet, a changed ask gets its answer). An unsent text is kept as taken back and leaves the queue if Tex has not started on it, with no turn.

nodes.label: Staff move a chat
nodes.goal: Staff move one chat at a time to Tex's new number from the console (Platform → Lines); once a minute the texting Worker takes the moves asked for, and this words the one text the old line sends: a person is told to text the new number from now on, a group that Tex is swapping numbers. A group first gets the new number added (Sendblue), then the note from the old number; when the new line hears that note among the same people (read from the bridge, since its event names only the sender) it ties the two groups together, so the group keeps its home and memory, and takes the old number out. No model; with no new number saved, nothing is sent.

nodes.label: Triage
nodes.goal: Code's rules before any judge: one text with nothing of Tex's waiting on it, a command, a setting or a yes code goes straight to the queue; several texts, a bare thanks, or a text that may leave an ask behind goes to Decide. In a group, a command said to Tex goes straight on, and every other line goes to Decide.

nodes.label: Decide
nodes.goal: Choose, from labelled examples, whether this text gets an answer, a reaction, a short wait or nothing, so Tex never answers what wasn't for it.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.goal: Keep one turn per chat at a time (groups up to three side by side) so two answers never race each other.

nodes.label: Read the text
nodes.goal: Read the request: who is asking, from which chat, and what they asked.

nodes.label: Run a routine
nodes.goal: For a routine's run: reload the routine, and stop here when it is paused or its job needs no model.

nodes.label: Check the question
nodes.goal: Check the question and what came with it: the files, the message it replies to, the tapbacks.

nodes.label: Settle a yes or no
nodes.goal: A texted yes or no settles a waiting approval here, in code, before any model runs.

nodes.label: Watch what leaves
nodes.goal: Start this turn's egress ledger: what it reads from outside and what it may send out.

nodes.label: Check it may run
nodes.goal: Start reading the tools and the history, and check the model may run here.

nodes.label: Read the history
nodes.goal: Hear voice messages, keep sent files, and read the chat's history and the tools offered.

nodes.label: Open the web
nodes.goal: Pick the write tools for this chat and open the browser, vouched for by the person's own words.

nodes.label: Read the setup
nodes.goal: Read Tex's setup: its prompt, history length, skills, models, router and fallback.

nodes.label: Bookkeeping
nodes.goal: Prepare what the turn records: usage, the turn log, the ledger turn id, the pictures to keep.

nodes.label: Prepare the answer
nodes.goal: Start the side read of Tex's notes and set up the answer checks and pictures.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.goal: Send a plain lookup to a cheaper path and keep the front door for changes and thinking.

nodes.label: Front door
nodes.goal: Write Tex's answer: read the chat, call the tools that do the work, and draft the reply.

nodes.label: Fallback
nodes.goal: Answer when the front door's model is down, so a text never goes unanswered.

nodes.label: Big-ask planner
nodes.goal: Break a big ask into steps before the front door starts, so it doesn't wander.

nodes.label: Tools
nodes.goal: Do the actual work in Context and the world: read, write, manage and send. Added only in code.

nodes.label: Advisor
nodes.goal: Think harder when the front door is stuck, and say what to try next.

nodes.label: Answer checks
nodes.goal: Catch what code can prove wrong in a draft (a claim with no call behind it, a figure in nothing the model saw, a missing link) before a model looks.
nodes.file: graph/nodes/checks.js · doItChecks.js · untriedWeb.js · sourcedFigures.js seenFiguresNotice · replyJudge.js codeCheck

nodes.label: Mail checker
nodes.goal: Read an email before it goes and stop one that is wrong, rude or to the wrong person.

nodes.label: Card check
nodes.goal: Check a card's fields match what was asked before it is shown.

nodes.label: Reply reviewer
nodes.goal: Read the draft as the person would and send it back when it misses, so they never get a wrong or lazy answer.

nodes.label: Text them
nodes.goal: Deliver the answer: the texts, any card, and a reaction, as the chat's service allows.

nodes.label: React
nodes.goal: Put Decide's tapback on their text straight away, so a thanks or a win gets a reaction without a reply.

outSchema.name: emoji
outSchema.options: Decide's pick, if on the allowlist

nodes.label: Classifier
nodes.goal: File each text into a conversation thread after the reply, so later turns see a short index instead of everything.

nodes.label: Self-review
nodes.goal: Look back at a sent answer and note what to do better next time.

nodes.label: Background job
nodes.goal: Do long work (browsing, forms, many steps) without holding up the reply.

nodes.label: Job check
nodes.goal: Check a job's work as it goes and steer it when it drifts.

nodes.label: Advisor on job mail
nodes.goal: Decide what to tell the person when a job gets mail it can't handle alone.

nodes.label: Hand-back judge
nodes.goal: Make sure what a job hands back is true and finished before the person hears it.

nodes.label: Egress judge
nodes.goal: Let a step that widens who can see something, or acts in the person's name, run only when the person's own words ask for it; anything but a clear yes is a no.

nodes.label: Picture maker
nodes.goal: Draw a card or graphic, or make a photo with Gemini, for a texted answer; every one is looked at by Card check before it may go.

nodes.label: Memory nudge
nodes.goal: Every ten texts, or when an answer was about them, write what was learned into About me now instead of waiting for the dream.

nodes.label: Reflect
nodes.goal: After a hard or corrected turn, write down what worked as a learned skill for next time.

nodes.label: Nightly
nodes.goal: Start each night's work for a person: the dream and the summaries of their days, and housekeeping, each on the schedule the control plane keeps.

nodes.label: Dream
nodes.goal: Read the chat since the last dream and the memories that fit, and keep About me true: add what was learned, take out what is no longer so.

nodes.label: Day summaries
nodes.goal: Sum up each finished day of the chat not yet summed up, into the chat's ledger, for later turns.

nodes.label: Housekeeping
nodes.goal: Tidy their workspace once a day within its time limit: fix what the health check names, change nothing it cannot undo, and log each change.

nodes.label: Door
nodes.goal: Gather what the turn needs (the text, routine, question, yes or no, what may leave, may it run, history, web, setup, bookkeeping) in code before any model runs; each part logged inside this step.

nodes.label: Staff messages
nodes.goal: Texts staff send through Tex from the console, such as the note that a chat is moving to Tex's new number; no model, worded in code, out through Bypass.

nodes.label: Job advisor
nodes.goal: Check a job's work as it goes and steer it when it drifts; advise on mail the job drafts before it leaves.

nodes.label: Learn
nodes.goal: After a texted turn, write what was learned: About me every ten texts or when the answer was about them, and a learned skill after a hard or corrected turn.

nodes.label: After the reply
nodes.goal: After the reply, file each text into a conversation thread and score the conversation, filing a review when something went wrong.

nodes.label: Answer check
nodes.goal: Check a draft before it goes: code first catches what it can prove wrong (a claim with no call behind it, a figure nothing showed, a missing link); for a report or routine a model then reads it as the person would. Either can send it back to the front door.

nodes.label: Confirmations & refusals
nodes.goal: Answers the door settles in code, with no model: a yes, no or thumbs-up to something Tex is waiting on (including a computer step), and the short refusals (a request that can't be read, a question too long, not allowed to run, the model unavailable). Logs which one and why, then hands it to Text them.

nodes.label: Chat day summaries
nodes.goal: After a reply, sum up each finished day of this chat (1:1 or group) in the last 3 weeks not yet summed up, 3 a run, into the chat's ledger, for the 7-day history to show before the last 7 days.
